episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Seunghyun has been in conflict with seniors who forced to discipline the students during training.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Eunkang has been accused of secretly filming the Cheongram training and now she has to leave school.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Eunkang, who could not stand the compelling Cheongram education, begins to rebel.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Seunghyun is disappointed at Eunkang, who is thinking about dropping out of school.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Eunkang decides to stay at school and accepts a blind date to find a new love with fresh emotions.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As midterms begin, students study hard to get ahead. Seunghyun witnesses Hyunseok cheating.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The campus is filled with excitement due to "Cheongram Sports Day."

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Eunkang comforts Juchan after he broke up with his girlfriend.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: After the first kiss, Seunghyun and Eunkang start a secret relationship on campus.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: As summer vacation begins, freshmen get ready for training at police substations.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: A respected young CEO, the true character of Jo Hansol, has been revealed.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: When everyone is asleep at dawn, Seunghyun and Eunkang kiss each other while watching the sunrise.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Seunghyun finds out about Kim Hyunsoo's death, a police university student who died 10 years ago.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Due to best friend Jo Hansol's trick, Seunghyun and Tak, are separated.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Seunghyun visits the police station and finds an oddity about the case based on Daeil's call.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Eunkang visits Hansol and he tries to kill Eunkang after he finds out her plan.
